method: Built-in image generation; conceptual product studies, not rendered CAD or validated packaging.
common: Use case: product-mockup. Create a beautiful, sophisticated industrial design concept rendering of Tinfox, a small twelve-actuator quadruped. Image 1 is a reference for actual mechanical proportions and scale; image 2 is a reference for finish quality and graceful organic structural limbs. Redesign the torso creatively according to the variant below. This is a design exploration, not a claim of engineering verification. Preserve four articulated legs, 170 mm thighs and shanks, circular proximal motor envelopes about 79 mm in diameter, independent fore/aft hip roll plus lateral hip pitch, and a simple concealed single-pushrod knee. No belts. Four small circular shoulder caps, no motors at the knees, no rigid shell bridging an articulated shoulder. Knee and shin have subtle continuous organic curves, slim hollow structural covers and small rounded rubber feet. Restrained precision-instrument aesthetic: warm ivory, graphite, bead-blasted aluminum, a few tiny orange service tabs. Refined flush seams, softly radiused edges, functional joints, realistic sensors and fasteners. Avoid a bulky rectangular trunk, decorative armor, cartoon features, exaggerated fins, or external product branding. Photoreal studio design visualization, warm light gray background, soft shadows, clear material separation, extremely polished appearance. Landscape image, one complete robot in a front-right three-quarter view with all four legs visible, plus a small matching top-view inset in the upper left to reveal the torso silhouette. Keep inset consistent with main design. Do not include captions, dimension text, or invented specifications. Preserve real component bulk rather than shrinking the motors into tiny joints.

variants.name: Pebble
variants.prompt: Variant 01 PEBBLE. A calm, sculptural floating carapace with an hourglass planform: modest local fullness at the four shoulder stations, a clearly pinched central waist, and softly tapered nose and tail. The white top curves gently over the component volumes with continuous highlights and small generous-radius edge transitions. Conceal two compact tool battery envelopes side by side in a dark recessed removable underside cassette; let the underside visually retreat behind the bright upper edge. White shoulders end before black annular roll gaps. Integrate the upper portions of the motor pods into local shaped recesses, never fuse them to the body. The body should look like a precisely carved smooth pebble, not a box with fillets. Flush dark binocular camera window in the nose, low centered lidar puck. Subtle slender crescent-shaped thigh profile and a graceful curved graphite shin. The most balanced, understated and approachable concept. Top inset must show the hourglass waist and local shoulder fullness.

variants.name: Keel
variants.prompt: Variant 02 KEEL. A visibly narrow central fuselage and an elegantly elongated underside battery keel. Two tool batteries are arranged one behind the other along the robot's centerline, rather than side by side; the dark streamlined keel must visibly project farther below the bright torso than in the reference because this arrangement trades belly clearance for reduced width. A thin ivory dorsal canopy sits above the narrow electronics channel. Four short exposed satin-metal transverse structural arms join the narrow torso to compact articulated shoulder pods, leaving beautiful clean negative space beside the waist. These arms are motor carriers, not rigid locked shoulders; show distinct black roll-axis interfaces. Athletic, light-looking and architectural. Let the nose and tail taper like a canoe, with softly rounded chines, no sharp weapons-like points. Retain realistic full-size proximal circular motor housings and the four subtly curved structural legs. The top inset must clearly show the narrow centerline body and separated shoulder stations; the long lower keel is apparent in the main three-quarter view.

variants.name: Twin Rail
variants.prompt: Variant 03 TWIN RAIL. A striking open-center torso built as two slim parallel longitudinal ivory equipment pods. There is a real visible dark/open channel of negative space between the two pods, not a painted stripe. One compact tool battery slides into the underside of each pod between the front and rear actuator stations; electronics are divided between the pods. Very small sculpted front and rear structural crossbridges join the rails and carry a flush binocular front camera and low rear lidar. No full-width central lid. The four round shoulder actuator housings nest into the ends of the equipment rails while keeping visible independent roll joints. Narrow satin-metal structural bridges and tiny orange release tabs, clean cable routing internally, minimal exposed hardware. Organic capsule-like pod surfaces with subtle asymmetrical scallops over the shoulders, not two plain cylinders or a ladder frame. The legs are especially refined with ivory curved load-bearing thighs and gently bowed graphite shins. Top inset must unmistakably show two elegant longitudinal rails and open central space. This should feel like an exquisitely detailed compact research instrument.

variants.name: Manta
variants.prompt: Variant 04 MANTA. The most fluid and visually low-slung concept. A shallow, broad ivory upper deck with swept concave flanks and a very thin visible leading edge; four smoothly sculpted local corner caps rise only where the real motor volumes require them. The upper surface has a slight central crown and blends into a recessed dark underside. The batteries remain side by side below the central deck and must retain a plausible dark belly volume; do not pretend that the whole robot torso is paper-thin. Spread low-profile electronics laterally under the shallow canopy instead of creating a tall central tower. Small low lidar on the rear deck, a flush curved black camera visor at the nose. Each shoulder has a deliberate black articulated gap between the deck and moving round motor pod, with no rigid body fairing attached across hip roll. A little more width in exchange for a very thin-looking torso, beautifully undercut flanks and sculpted wheel-arch-like shoulder recesses without wheels. Smooth surfacing, no sharp fins, no excessive ornament. More sculpted and flowing upper legs with elegant narrow knees and curved lower legs. The top inset must show the swept manta-like planform, narrow nose, gently waisted flanks and full corner motor volumes.
